items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Well Chris started me off, yeah. He turned the horn and I went to him for quite a while.

ctx.x: That's right. And you said you had Chris at some point.
Well Chris started me off, yeah. He turned the horn and I went to him for quite a while. I started first after I'd formed the band. You see.
What did he teach you exactly? Reading?

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Well, when I first started and got the band together, I used to play exactly like he played with the mute.

ctx.x: Somebody told me once that, of course I've heard you play Careless Love a lot of times, and you made a couple of nice records of it. Did you ever try, I'm not trying to accuse you of imitating anybody, but I mean did you ever try to sort of play like Chris's?

Well, when I first started and got the band together, I used to play exactly like he played with the mute. I had the wah-wah and everything, and all the time he could tell the difference. When they'd come into the hall, because the Al Jays and all the people was crazy about Chris, and he used to send me on a lot of jobs. Well, they did think it was Chris that would be me playing.
